product_metadata.title: T-Fal Textiles 22418 2-Pack 100-Percent Cotton Print Dual Sided Dish Cloths, Red Multi Pattern, 4 Pack, Stripe Cool
features: Dual-Purpose. Soft 100% cotton crafted with one weave side offering lint-free drying capabilities and its terry-looped counterpart providing maximum absorbency.
Fashion meets function. A bevy of fun designs lets you choose the option that best suits your taste.
Everlasting vibrancy. Thoughtfully designed to ensure colors remain vibrant and design integrity endures.
Generously sized. Boasting ample 12 in. by 12 in. (30 cm by 30 cm) dimensions means making short work of the tallest of tasks.
description: Animate your cleaning regiment with the colorful pop of our T-fal Print Dual Kitchen Dish Cloth value pack. This spirited set includes four 12 in. x 12 in. (30 cm by 30 cm) dual-sided dish cloths crafted from soft 100% cotton. Each dual-purpose towel also offers a one-two punch of practicality thanks to a lintless, woven side that sees to streak-free drying while its terry-looped counterpart is designed for maximum absorbency. Hassle-free, machine-wash maintenance won’t dull colors, meaning towels remain a vibrant household mainstay for years to come.
